description_en: Queries the check results of data protection rules
description_zh: 查询数据保护规则检查结果
name: DescribeCheckDetails

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the resource
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data protection rule. Optional. If not specified, results are not filtered by rule
parameters.help_zh: 数据保护规则唯一标识。可选。不填则不按规则过滤
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the previous API call. For more information about how to view the returned data, see the operation description above
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。有关本接口查看返回数据的设置方式，请参见上文接口说明
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results
